name: SVR Poker Android
nextApkDrop: Only after the user explicitly requests the next APK update.
notes: Phase 342 adds separate Android, Quest, desktop, and Camera 3 performance budgets.
Adaptive quality responds only to sustained FPS or renderer pressure and never creates duplicate render loops.
Android and Camera 3 disable shadows, lower anisotropy, and suppress diagnostic geometry.
Quest targets 72 FPS with full foveation and a conservative framebuffer scale before XR session start.
Texture uploads and shader compilation are prewarmed before presentation where supported.
Asset-load timings and renderer statistics are exposed through Phase 342 runtime QA.
A GitHub Actions audit identifies legacy models, uncompressed textures, duplicates, and large assets.
A manual optimization workflow produces Meshopt-compressed GLB and WebP output artifacts.
Automatic update prompts are disabled; the update panel opens only through an explicit manual command.
